_note: Explore movement tuning (player only). Old values: run 2.3 m/s, sprint 4.6 m/s, crouch 1.2 m/s, no prone, gravity 9.81 m/s^2, jump 4.2 m/s, eyes 1.62 / 1.05 m. Speeds then x1.25 (run 2.875, sprint 5.75; crouch 1.2, prone 0.6), then all four x1.1 (run 3.1625, sprint 6.325, crouch 1.32, prone 0.66), now all four x0.85 (gunplay overhaul 2026-11-08: run 2.688, sprint 5.376, crouch 1.122, prone 0.561; the bots read these too, src/ai_core.cpp). Getting up was ~0.3 s (eye smoothing only); now timed: prone->stand 1.1 s, prone->crouch 0.75 s, crouch->stand 0.45 s, at the lower posture speed, no sprint until done (jumping is held back only while getting up from prone). Space when prone stands up. Jump: a press up to jumpBuffer_s before landing still jumps on touchdown, and up to coyote_s after leaving settled ground. SPEC 4 (MP update): jump apex x1.2, airtime x0.75 from the previous g 7.848 / jump 3.757 (apex 0.8993 m, airtime 0.9574 s): h 1.0791 m, t 0.7181 s, g = 8h/t^2 = 16.742 (x2.1333), v0 = sqrt(2gh) = 6.011 m/s. World physics (grenades, ragdolls, droplets, bots' agents) stays at 9.81. fallDamage: heights in data, converted at load to impact speeds with this gravity (v = sqrt(2 g h)): no damage below safeHeight_m, death at lethalHeight_m, linear in impact speed between.

vault._note: Hold Space (hold_s) at an obstacle whose top is minHeight_m-maxHeight_m above the feet, at most maxDepth_m deep, landing no more than maxDrop_m below the top; swept, no chaining, never over barbed wire (src/explore.cpp). Taller or deeper obstacles are climbed by the mantle below.

mantle._note: Hold Space facing a ledge minHeight_m-maxHeight_m above the ground under the feet (trench lips are 1.9-2.0 m above the floor, 1.57 m above the firestep; 2.15 keeps a 2.1 m wall in range). Lands on top where the standing body fits (top within landAbove_m / landBelow_m of the ledge, 0.42-1.6 m past the face), or drops over a top narrower than narrowTop_m to a far side at most maxDrop_m down. Duration minDuration_s-maxDuration_s by the rise; the view pitches up by pitchUp_deg while pulling and down by pitchDip_deg rolling over the top; hands handSpread_m either side of the aim line. Vault is tried first. Bot mantle links (content/ai/navigation.json links.mantleMax_m 1.6) stay inside this range. src/mantle.cpp, docs/movement.md#mantle.

swim._note: Swimming (src/swim.cpp, docs/movement.md#swimming). Water is waterAt(): the global sea level, V1 water assets and lasso water bodies. Swim above enterDepth_m of water over the feet, walk again below exitDepth_m once grounded; floating, the feet hang floatDepth_m under the surface (eye ~0.24 m above it). Space rises, Ctrl dives, the look steers W/S when submerged or looking more than diveSteerPitch_deg down. Buoyancy drifts back up at buoyancy_mps; velocity follows the wish at drag_per_s. Surface bob bobAmp_m at bobHz plus the stroke, roll_deg with the stroke. breath_s with the eye under water, breathRecover_per_s back above; then drownDamage_hps HP per second every drownTick_s (rules damage path, match only). Underwater fog: underwaterFog_per_m, underwaterFogColor (linear).
